title: Brand partnership Manager
description:
**Company Description**
AI Twin is a technology company focused on creating AI-driven solutions that enable brands to sell and engage with customers 24/7. The organization develops intelligent digital tools that support continuous customer interaction, sales, and service across multiple channels. By leveraging advanced automation and data-driven insights, AI Twin helps businesses scale their operations and improve customer experiences. Team members collaborate in a dynamic, innovation-focused environment to deliver impactful solutions for clients.
  
**Role Description**
The Brand Partnership Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai. This position is responsible for identifying, developing, and managing strategic brand partnerships that drive growth and visibility for AI Twin and its clients. Daily tasks include prospecting potential partners, leading pitch meetings, negotiating partnership terms, and overseeing ongoing account management to ensure partner satisfaction and performance. The role also involves analyzing partnership outcomes, preparing reports, coordinating with internal teams such as marketing, product, and sales, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders. The Brand Partnership Manager will contribute to partnership strategy, market outreach, and collaborative campaigns that support long-term business objectives.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Strategic Partnerships and Partnerships skills, with experience in identifying, building, and nurturing long-term brand relationships.
* Candidates should possess solid Account Management skills, including the ability to oversee partner activities, maintain partner satisfaction, and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, with the ability to present proposals, negotiate terms, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills, with the ability to evaluate partnership performance, interpret data, and provide actionable insights.
* Experience in business development, marketing, or brand management, preferably in technology or SaaS industries.
* Ability to work on-site in Chennai, collaborate cross-functionally, and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; relevant professional certifications are a plus.
* Proficiency with CRM tools, presentation software, and basic data analysis tools; familiarity with AI or digital solutions is beneficial.

title: Relationship Manager - Business Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

About the role

At ICICI Bank, you get an opportunity to engage with high-value customers of ICICI Bank and offer 360 degree-banking solutions. As a Relationship Manager - Business Banking, you will have the opportunity to provide banking solutions for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) and mid-size corporates. You will collaborate with various teams within the Bank to ensure a quick turnaround time for all client requirements. You will continuously strive to extend our market reach through expert discovery and exploration of new and untapped business opportunities and relationships. Following the Bank’s philosophy of Fair to Customer, Fair to Bank, you will take the initiative and help ICICI Bank to become the preferred Bank amongst the target group. Key accountabilities include customer feedback and defined business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Customer Service**

Create service excellence by collaborating with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their finances.

**Business Development**

Ensuring growth in Deposits and Loan books by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Cross selling & Collaboration**

Offer products based on customer needs while collaborating with other teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality**

Maintain the quality of the loan book and conduct due diligence on the business flows and overdue.

**Customised Solutions**

Collaborate with product specialists, subject matter experts, and credit and service teams to ensure structured and customised solutions.

**Behold our values**

Work to uphold our core value of being Fair to Customer, Fair to Bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification**

MBA, Chartered Accountants, Engineers & Graduates with relevant work experience in the area of Relationship Management across industries.

**Synergise with Team**

Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise**

Develop and implement an overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes, and structure.

**Communication Skill**

Good oral and written communication skills.

**Market Sensing**

Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships.

**About the Business Group**

ICICI Bank’s Retail Banking Group serves customer segments consisting of individuals, self-employed professionals, SMEs, proprietors, government, and retail institutions. With widespread presence across the country, our relationship team is dedicated to serving customer needs with a 360-degree approach. ICICI Bank has a unique bouquet of digital solutions covering the diverse banking needs of customers. To facilitate a seamless customer banking experience, we have adopted the ICICI Stack approach. It covers a complete range of banking services from bank accounts, payments, banking transactions, and credit cards to personal, mortgage, vehicle loans, and business & institutional solutions. Here are a few videos that you may want to go through on the products and services of the Bank.

title: Insurance Delivery -Senior-Manager -Hyderabad, Chennai, TVM
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting - Senior Manager, Insurance Delivery (Guidewire and Insurance Platforms)**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an accomplished Senior Delivery Manager with 15+ years of experience to lead complex Insurance technology engagements for global clients. The role requires broad functional and technical understanding of Guidewire InsuranceSuite, surrounding digital and integration platforms, and a strong command of service management and ITIL principles. The successful candidate will own client outcomes, delivery performance, financial health, service quality, people leadership and continuous improvement across a large engagement or a portfolio of engagements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, complex or multiple Insurance engagements across implementation, transformation, application maintenance and support, enhancements, integration, testing, release and production operations.
* Provide executive governance across scope, schedule, quality, SLAs, risks, dependencies and benefits, with clear accountability for committed client outcomes.
* Lead geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams across onshore, nearshore and offshore locations, including service managers, architects, functional consultants, engineering, testing, DevOps and service management teams.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders, product owners and third-party partners, and act as the senior escalation point for delivery and service matters.
* Establish and run governance forums, steering committees, service reviews and executive reporting with fact-based insights, decisions and actions.
* Drive predictable delivery through integrated planning, demand and capacity management, dependency management, release readiness, quality gates and disciplined change control.
* Own performance against contractual service levels and experience measures; lead recovery plans where performance is at risk and ensure transparent reporting of trends and corrective actions.
* Oversee major incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis, change and release management, service transition, knowledge management and operational resilience.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned processes, client controls, security requirements, regulatory obligations, audit expectations and delivery standards.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, shift-left, observability, engineering excellence and AI-enabled operations to improve reliability, responsiveness and cost efficiency.
* Support solutioning, estimation, proposal development, transition planning and mobilization for new opportunities and scope expansion.
* Develop leadership capability and succession across the account; coach managers and senior team members, manage performance, improve retention and build a strong delivery culture.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Guidewire and platform leadership**

* Broad knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, including configuration, integration, data, digital channels, rating, batch processing, rules, workflows and reporting.
* Understanding of Guidewire Cloud delivery and operations, cloud migration considerations, platform upgrades, environment strategy, deployment pipelines and production support models.
* Ability to oversee Guidewire integrations with policy, claims, billing, document, payment, finance, customer relationship management, data, analytics, identity and other enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of modern architecture and engineering practices involving APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, middleware, cloud services, secure DevOps, automated delivery pipelines, test automation and observability.
* Working knowledge of adjacent Insurance platforms and technologies such as digital portals, data and analytics platforms, document and content management, rating solutions, enterprise integration and cloud infrastructure.

**Service management and operational excellence**

* Practical application of ITIL principles across incident, major incident, problem, change, release, request, configuration, knowledge, availability, capacity and service-level management.
* Experience establishing operating models, service governance, escalation paths, responsibility structures, support coverage, on-call models and service improvement plans.
* Ability to use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns, service risks, demand drivers and improvement opportunities, and convert insights into measurable actions.

**Leadership and delivery attributes**

* Strong Insurance domain understanding, preferably Property and Casualty, across policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims and related business processes.
* Proven success delivering large-scale or multi-account technology engagements for global clients, with accountability for distributed teams and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate confidently across executive governance, commercial management, delivery detail and technical risk while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Strong leadership presence, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills.
* Commercial acumen covering estimation, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, productivity, contract interpretation and change control.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, scaled delivery and traditional delivery methods, with the judgment to apply fit-for-purpose governance.
* Working familiarity with service and engineering tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, monitoring platforms, knowledge repositories and automated delivery toolchains.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of overall experience in technology delivery, including substantial leadership experience in Insurance engagements.
* Proven experience as a Senior Delivery Manager, Program Manager, Account Delivery Lead or equivalent, managing a large engagement or multiple concurrent teams across global clients.
* Demonstrable delivery knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, plus associated digital, integration, data and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading implementation and/or managed services engagements with responsibility for service performance, client governance, financials, people and risk.
* Strong understanding of ITIL and service management principles, including practical experience across incident, problem, change, release and service-level management.
* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Guidewire certification in one or more InsuranceSuite modules; broader cross-module or cloud credentials are advantageous.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Program or project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an Agile certification.
* Experience with Guidewire Cloud, cloud transformation, complex platform modernization or large-scale service transition.
* Exposure to solution shaping, presales, contract negotiations, account growth and capability development.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager - Investments (Chennai)
description:
**Company Description**

NJ Macson is led by seasoned bankers with extensive experience in Corporate Finance, Commercial Banking, Investment Banking, and Private Wealth Management. Acting as a trusted advisory board, the firm provides innovative, unbiased financial solutions to support clients in achieving their financial goals. Based in Chennai, NJ Macson offers comprehensive family office services, managing assets, fostering relationships, and ensuring confidentiality. The company is dedicated to creating lasting value for families across generations.

**Role Description:**
This is a full-time on-site role for a Wealth Manager at NJ Macson in Chennai. The Manager will be responsible for driving loan sales, monitoring market trends, managing client relationships and overseeing the loan application process. The candidate should acknowledge that success in this role requires a perfect combination of exceptional service, expert advisory solutions and unique benefits, all tailored to help our customers achieve their financial goals and priorities.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Establish relationships with high-net-worth individuals (HNIs) and ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNIs) to expand the Private Wealth Group.
* Leverage networking, referrals and targeted outreach to build a robust client base, ensuring the group’s growth, long-term success and expansion of client portfolio.
* Engage in cross-selling efforts, promoting a wide range of financial products and services that include Mutual Fund, PMS, AIF, General Insurance, Loans etc. to align with the company's strategic goals.
* Actively pursue new client acquisition and handle new customer onboarding.
* Developing personalized financial plans and investment strategies aligned with client's objectives and risk profiles.
* Evaluate investment opportunities, drive revenue growth and exceed any proposed targets while considering factors such as risk, return potential and liquidity.
* Foster long-term relationships and ongoing advisory support while providing proactive wealth management solutions to UHNIs.
* Stay well-versed with new financial products, services and advisory solutions and be updated about financial markets, emerging trends and developments within the investment landscape.
* Collaborate with internal teams, such as tax advisors, auditors, legal and sales professionals, to offer comprehensive financial solutions to clients.
* Provide proactive supervision of client portfolios, ensuring alignment with evolving financial goals and market conditions while optimizing portfolio performance.
* Ensure all client interactions, financial advice and product recommendations are in line with regulatory protocols and company policies.
* Regularly compile and update detailed MIS reports that highlight key metrics, client interactions, sales progress and reflects real-time updates on portfolio performance and client’s status.

**Qualifications:**

* BBA or equivalent Bachelor’s degree is an essential requirement
* MBA or equivalent Master’s degree is an essential requirement
* Additional Trainings or Certifications would be an added advantage.

**Knowledge:**

* Aware of the latest industry trends relating to wealth planning and management, investment advisory and portfolio management.
* Good understanding of Investments and Wealth products such as Mutual Funds, PMS, AIF, Bonds etc.
* Good overall knowledge of local and international markets.

**Experience:**

* 5 - 10 + years of experience in wealth management, private banking, financial planning, investment advisory or portfolio management.
* Experienced in client relationship management or managing HNIs/UHNIs while providing investment or financial advisory services.

**Skills:**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Persevering, enthusiastic, motivated and self-driven.
* Proven track record of achieving business development targets.
* Ability to develop and maintain good client relationships.
* Ability to handle client objections and resolve issues effectively.

Full-time, Permanent

- Financial Services

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
The Customer Experience Manager is responsible for leading and scaling contact center operations within the GSC, ensuring alignment with business strategy and delivering high-quality customer outcomes. The role drives operational performance, organizational capability, and customer experience strategy across CX teams, while enabling growth, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage CX Contact Center operations, ensuring alignment with regional and global strategy.
* Define and execute customer experience strategy to meet customer needs across products, segments, and markets.
* Oversee team structure, workforce planning, and organizational design to support operational scalability.
* Lead, coach, and develop Team Leaders and CX teams, fostering a high-performance and customer-centric culture.
* Ensure achievement of service levels, KPIs, and operational targets through structured performance management.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and quality.
* Develop and implement business continuity plans for critical customer processes.
* Monitor performance trends, identify risks, and implement corrective action plans.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless customer journeys and service delivery.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Identify growth opportunities, including up-sell and cross-sell initiatives aligned with business strategy.

**Accountabilities**

* Delivery of CX performance against KPIs (service levels, productivity, customer satisfaction).
* Organizational capability development, including leadership pipeline and team performance.
* Execution of strategic initiatives and continuous improvement plans.
* Operational resilience and continuity of customer-facing processes.

**Required Qualification, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8 + years of experience in contact center management or similar leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience managing managers or large teams.
* Proven ability to drive performance, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to operate in complex, fast-paced environments and manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in building and scaling operations.

**Required Business/ Technical Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of contact center operations and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of customer experience frameworks and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience with tools such as SAP and advanced Excel.
* Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma and/or project management methodologies.
* Understanding of logistics and supply chain operations (preferred).

**Key measures**

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Service Level / Phone Accessibility
* Productivity and operational efficiency
* Average Handle Time (AHT) and Average Speed of Answer (ASA)
* Shrinkage and workforce effectiveness
* Volume growth and churn management

**Shift Timings**

* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, based on business requirements.
* Willingness to work in a 5-day workweek schedule, which may include weekends as part of the roster.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Working as part of the Consulting team, you will take part in engagements related to a wide range of topics. Some examples of domains in which you will support our clients include the following:
  
  

* Defined Benefits Operations (E.g. - Benefits calculations, Benefits Review), Benefits Calculation for Retirement, Termination, Disability, Death, Divorce.
* ERISA Compliance - US Retirement Plan Testing (ADP & ACP Testing, Corrective Distribution) & Reporting experience.
* Deep understanding of in-plan guaranteed income products such as annuities embedded within defined contribution plans (e.g., target date funds with income guarantees).
* Experience in designing or evaluating protected retirement solutions through insurance-wrapped investment vehicles.
* Exposure to recordkeeping platform enhancements to support in-plan income features, including income projection tools, guarantee tracking, and participant-level income illustrations.
* Money in and Loans -Must have experience in handling money in & Loan related activities, i.e. Check processing, contribution, loan initiation, Loan repayments, re-amortization etc.
* Disbursements: Distributions/Disbursements such as Hardship withdrawals, QDRO, RMD, In-service distributions, loans or experience in processing 401K contribution, loan repayments etc.
* Understanding of business rules of Payout, Qualified/Non-Qualified Plans, Roth Conversion, Roth IRA, Fiduciaries, Defined contribution, Defined Benefits/Pension
* Exposure to Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation (PBGC) study and Public Pensions
* Understanding of plan administration, group and account setup, eligibility
* Understanding of Vesting rules and Investment management
* Knowledge of middle office and back-office processing (retirement account origination, servicing, funds payout, reconciliation of funds, etc.)
* Experience supporting or leading PMO functions for large-scale retirement transformation programs, including project planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder reporting

Proven ability to coordinate across business, technology, and vendor teams, ensuring alignment with project timelines, scope, and quality standards in retirement platform implementations or upgrades
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Consulting Skills –**

* Experience in creating business process map for future state architecture, creating WBS for overall conversion strategy, requirement refinement process in multi-vendor engagement.
* Worked on multiple Business transformation and modernization programs.
* Conducted multiple Due-Diligence and Assessment projects as part of Transformation roadmaps to evaluate current state maturity, gaps in functionalities and COTs solution features.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Managing service delivery within the agreed service level across multiple blended processes
* Implement operational governance framework quality review mechanism, communication strategy.

**Technology Skills –**

* Proficient in technology solution architecture, with a focus on designing innovative and effective solutions.
* Experienced in data migration projects, ensuring seamless transfer of data between systems while maintaining data integrity and security.
* Skilled in data analytics, utilizing various tools and techniques to extract insights and drive informed decision-making.
* Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices, ensuring data quality and compliance.
* Collaborative team player, able to work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to define requirements and implement effective solutions.

Industry certifications (ASPPA/LOMA/ RPF) will be added advantage.
  
  
Experience on these solutions is preferrable.
  
  
ALIS
  
  
OMNI

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Regional Key Account Manager
description:
**The Opportunity**

At Plum, our offline business continues to grow, and Modern Trade plays an important role in bringing our products closer to consumers across India.

We're looking for a Regional Key Account Manager – Modern Trade who can help us build a stronger, more visible and higher-performing Plum presence across Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

This is not just about managing retail accounts. It's about building businesses within those accounts—strengthening customer partnerships, improving in-store execution, driving Beauty Advisor (BA) productivity and finding new opportunities to grow.

You'll work with some of the region's leading retail partners, including Health & Glow, Lulu, Reliance, More Retail, Apollo, DMart, Star Bazaar, Purplle, NewU and other regional chains.

We're looking for someone who enjoys being close to the market, understands what drives consumers to pick a product off the shelf, and knows how to turn strong retail relationships into measurable business growth.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Build & Grow Key Accounts**

* Own revenue, growth and commercial performance across assigned Modern Trade accounts.
* Build strong relationships with key retail partners and identify opportunities to expand Plum's business.
* Drive primary and secondary sales alignment, fill rates and account-level business plans.
* Negotiate and execute promotional calendars, visibility investments and in-store activations.
* Identify growth opportunities across stores, categories, assortments and new product launches.

**2. Make Plum Win at the Shelf**

* Ensure strong on-shelf availability, impactful visibility and planogram compliance across priority stores.
* Identify store-level execution gaps and drive timely corrective actions.
* Work closely with retail partners and field teams to improve product discovery and consumer conversion.
* Ensure launches, promotions and visibility plans translate into stronger sell-out performance.

**3. Build a High-Performing Field Force**

* Lead and guide Key Account Executives, Supervisors, Merchandisers and Beauty Advisors across assigned accounts.
* Drive BA productivity through better deployment, training, coaching and performance reviews.
* Track key metrics such as sales per BA, store-level market share, target achievement and man-day productivity.
* Build accountability and execution discipline across field teams.
* Ensure incentive plans are implemented accurately and on time.

**4. Turn Data into Growth Decisions**

* Track account-wise and store-wise sales, stock availability, productivity and promotional performance.
* Identify what's working, what's not and where the next growth opportunity lies.
* Lead structured Monthly Business Reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Use market intelligence and competitor insights to strengthen account strategies.
* Translate data into clear actions that improve revenue, visibility and productivity.

**5. Drive Commercial & Operational Excellence**

* Ensure timely closure of customer claims, reconciliations and No-Dues Certificates (NDCs).
* Partner with Finance and Channel teams to maintain strong financial and commercial discipline.
* Ensure adherence to agreed account terms, investments and promotional commitments.
* Work closely with Supply Chain and internal teams to resolve availability and operational issues.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in Modern Trade / Key Account Management, preferably within FMCG or consumer products.
* Strong understanding of the Tamil Nadu and Kerala Modern Trade landscape.
* Hands-on experience managing BA and Non-BA retail accounts.
* Experience working with regional or national retail chains and managing commercial relationships.
* Good understanding of sell-in, sell-out, inventory, visibility, promotions and retail productivity.
* Strong negotiation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently drive account performance and manage field execution.
* High ownership, commercial orientation and willingness to spend time in the market.
* Exposure to Beauty & Personal Care would be an advantage.
* Must be based in Chennai.

If you believe great brands are built not just through marketing, but also by winning every day at the shelf, we'd love to hear from you.

Come help us make Plum a stronger consumer choice across Tamil Nadu & Kerala!

title: Account Director
description:
**Role Purpose**

To lead client relationships, drive strategic thinking and deliver integrated marketing and communication solutions across traditional and digital channels. The Account Director is responsible for understanding clients’ business objectives, translating them into effective brand and marketing strategies, ensuring excellent execution, and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.

The role requires a strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, content, performance marketing and data-led communication, alongside conventional advertising and brand building.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Relationship Management**

- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key client stakeholders.

- Develop a thorough understanding of clients’ businesses, categories, consumers, competition and marketing objectives.

- Act as the senior point of contact for assigned accounts and proactively address client needs.

- Build client confidence through strategic inputs, proactive recommendations and consistent delivery.

**2. Brand Strategy and Integrated Planning**

- Translate business and marketing objectives into effective brand and communication strategies.

- Lead the development of annual brand plans, campaign briefs and integrated communication roadmaps.

- Integrate traditional advertising, digital marketing, social media, content and other relevant channels into cohesive brand solutions.

- Bring consumer insights, category intelligence, cultural trends and competitive analysis into strategic recommendations.

- Identify opportunities for brands to strengthen their positioning, relevance and engagement across consumer touchpoints.

**3. Digital Marketing and Social Media**

- Develop a strong understanding of digital ecosystems and their role in achieving brand and business objectives.

- Lead client discussions on digital strategy, social media, content planning, audience engagement and online brand building.

- Guide the development of digital-first campaigns, platform-specific content and always-on communication plans.

- Stay abreast of emerging platforms, digital trends, consumer behaviour and marketing technologies, including AI-led opportunities.

- Ensure digital initiatives are integrated with the overall brand strategy rather than operating as disconnected activities.

**4. Campaign Management and Execution**

- Oversee campaigns from briefing and planning through creative development, production, approval and execution.

- Coordinate delivery across creative, digital, social media, media, production and external partners.

- Ensure campaign quality, brand consistency, platform relevance and adherence to timelines and budgets.

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of execution.

- Ensure clear briefs, defined deliverables, approval processes and accountability across teams.

**5.Business Development and Account Growth**

- Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts across integrated communication, digital, social media, content and other agency services.

- Proactively recommend solutions based on emerging client needs and business opportunities.

- Develop strategic proposals, presentations and recommendations for the client.

- Strengthen client partnerships by demonstrating the agency’s ability to deliver measurable business and brand value.

**6.Commercial and Financial Management**

- Manage account budgets, estimates, billing, purchase orders and payment follow-ups in coordination with finance.

- Maintain accurate revenue forecasts and project cost tracking.

- Ensure commercial discipline across both traditional and digital deliverables.

**7.Team Leadership and Collaboration**

- Lead, mentor and develop account management team members.

- Establish clear responsibilities, timelines and accountability for deliverables.

- Collaborate effectively with creative, digital, social media, media specialists.

- Ensure teams work towards shared client objectives and integrated solutions.

- Foster a proactive, solution-oriented and collaborative working culture.

**8.Reporting and Account Governance**

- Maintain account plans, campaign trackers, meeting minutes and action reports.

- Keep agency leadership informed about account health, revenue opportunities, risks and client feedback.

- Ensure client commitments are tracked and fulfilled.

- Maintain clear communication and efficient workflows between clients and internal teams.

Required Skills and Experience

- 8–12 years of experience in advertising, marketing communications or an integrated agency environment.

- Strong client servicing, relationship management, presentation and communication skills.

- Good understanding of brand strategy, integrated campaigns and consumer behaviour.

- Working knowledge of digital marketing, social media strategy, content marketing and performance marketing.

- Ability to interpret digital campaign reports, understand KPIs and derive actionable insights.

- Familiarity with paid, owned and earned media, digital platforms and emerging marketing technologies.

- Strong project management, commercial acumen and financial discipline.

- Ability to lead teams, manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines.

- A proactive mindset, strategic orientation and strong sense of ownership.

Interested candidate share CV at alrina.alvares@rkswamy.com

title: City Lead
description:
We operate through two key sales channels — Spinny Retail and Spinny Partners (B2B Auction platform).

●
**Retail:**
We purchase used cars on our inventory, refurbish them at our owned workshops, and sell them through our retail outlets in Hub and Park formats

●
**Auction:**
We enable digital auctions for used car dealers based on in-house inspection reports. Prices are offered to sellers only after a confirmed dealer bid, ensuring minimal inventory risk.

The Supply vertical (car procurement) is common to both channels. Every incoming car runs through the Auction platform for the best price discovery, leveraging our network of 10,000+ channel partners, including Spinny Retail.

**SUPPLY CHANNELS**

We operate two primary procurement channels:

● G1 (Online C2B): Direct sellers who connect with Spinny digitally

● G3 (Offline B2B): Partnerships with new car dealerships, OEMs, leasing companies and corporate sellers

**G1 SUPPLY FUNNEL**

1. Lead Generation: Through Spinny’s digital platforms (website and app)

2. Inside Supply: A telecalling team that qualifies leads and schedules car evaluations at the customer’s preferred time and location

3. Inspection Ops: A fleet of technical evaluators who work in defined slots, moving from one scheduled evaluation to another. Each evaluator starts and ends their day from their home location 4. Closure: A tele-sales team responsible for price negotiation with sellers. They attempt to bridge price gaps by collaborating with sales teams, and schedule delivery once the price is agreed

5. Delivery Ops: A team of drivers and documentation agents who manage the final pickup, verify documentation, and trigger payment upon approval.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Lead Ground Operations (G1 Supply):**

● Oversee evaluation, delivery, documentation, and logistics for the G1 channel

● Drive key operational KPIs including fulfilment of scheduled evaluations and deliveries, operational SOP adherence, and quality metrics

● Manage hiring, training, daily operational planning and performance monitoring for the on-ground fleet

**2. Scale G3 Channel (B2B Supply):**

● Own the end-to-end funnel for the G3 channel — from lead generation to final delivery and price negotiations

● Lead growth and P&L for the G3 vertical in the respective geography

● Develop and execute strategies to expand partnerships with new car dealerships to maximise procurements from the exchange enquiries

● Manage a team of Business Development Managers (BDMs) responsible for relationship management and lead generation

**REQUIREMENTS**

● 3-6 yrs. of professional work experience, preferably have worked at a high growth startup/FMCG/FMCD in an execution driven role.

● Graduate from Tier 1/2 College/University.

● Good stakeholder management skills.

● Excellent written, communication, research, and analytical skills.

● Ability to think creatively about business problems and come up with solutions.

● Previous team management/leadership ability to lead teams of at least 15-20 members.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Technology Consulting
description:

We are headquartered in the Silicon Valley and have our delivery centres across the globe.

The below role is for our Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.

**About the role:**

As
**Delivery Partner - Technology Consulting,**
you will be performing the role of Global Service delivery manager for various D&A products built and managed for a set of Tiger clientele.

In doing so, you will closely collaborate with program leads, technology architects and data scientists across global locations.

In this Global Service delivery Manager role, below are some of the Key R&R: As a Global Service Delivery Manager:

Guarantee 99%+ refresh reliability across all data products (daily, weekly, real-time refreshes). Oversee incident response for failed data pipelines, schema drift, API timeouts, or data quality breaches.

Define and enforce Tier 1–3 support workflows, Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).

Implement DQ and BQ testing (Manual Automated) to ensure data accuracy before reports update.

Manage data refresh dependencies, batch scheduling, and resource allocation to prevent cluster/warehouse bottlenecks during peak hours.

Monitor cloud data platform costs associated with entire portfolio and enable implementation of auto-scaling, query optimization, and idle compute termination to optimize cloud consumption.

**Track active user metrics across all the products:**

* Daily Active Users (DAU), Monthly Active Users (MAU), query count, and top-utilized dashboards. Identify "dormant" or low-usage products (e.g., <5 views/month) to run targeted re-engagement campaigns or sunset them to save cost.
* Manage product versions, feature updates, and deprecation roadmap for obsolete dashboards or legacy pipelines.
* Conduct quarterly product reviews with business owners to ensure data products still match changing business logic.
* Establish user feedback loops (NPS/CSAT surveys) integrated directly into BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and web applications
* Deploy automated mechanisms to identify data anomalies, unexpected row-count spikes, or volume drops before products refresh for end-users.
* Utilize AI tools for automated root-cause analysis (RCA) on pipeline failures, cutting developer troubleshooting time.
* For ML products -ensure monitoring for model drift, data drift, and performance degradation. Collaborate with Data Science / AI teams to manage re-training schedules for ML Models.
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for onshore D&A leaders, product owners, and business unit leads.
* Lead daily standups, weekly operational reviews, and monthly service reviews across time zones. Lead and mentor an offshore team of Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, BI Developers, and L1/L2 Support Engineers.
* Up-skill team members on GenAI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SQL AI assistants) to accelerate sprint velocity and pipeline debugging.
* Manage resource capacity across routine maintenance (refreshes/SLA), bug fixes, and new product enhancement requests.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

**Experience: 15+ years**

* Service Delivery Management, Support & Operations (DataOps)E2E Service delivery mgmt. experience (10+ yrs) with strong ITIL foundational skills with emphasis on SLA/SLO enforcement, MTTD/MTTR optimization, incident response, Problem mgmt.
* Change mgmt. etc.
* Strong exposure on the Foundational skills Across o Cloud & FinOps, o Data Engineering workflows/pipelines o BI and Web Application o ML Applications and Workflows
* Must be AI-Enabled/AI-Native and ensure his/her team embraces the power of AI as appropriate Extensive experience in managing stakeholders across the Globe, ensuring ontime Executive reporting, periodic governance
* Should have worked on RFP’s/RFI’s as a bid manager ensure ownership on E2E delivery of the response
* Seasoned Thought leader, bringing in latest and greatest technical/process ideas to life in the delivery lifecycle and generate more value for the customers
* Multi-timezone operations, ITIL frameworks, Agile/Scrum leadership (standups, service reviews), onshore/offshore SPOC
* Solution design and delivery experience on different data platforms
* Experience in setting up offshore teams from scratch and institutionalize processes/ways of working, Team capability building & upskilling etc.
* Exposure to DevOps in the context of cloud-based solution deployment (MLOps exposure preferable)

Interested candidates please share the resume to
**steffie.sheeba@tigeranalytics.com**
or apply to this job.

title: Manager - Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC)- SAP FICO | Vertex | ONESOURCE | Avalara | Sovos - Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
You will lead and support SAP-enabled tax transformation efforts for US-based clients, helping organizations improve the way tax integrates with enterprise processes and technology. As part of Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited, this role sits at the intersection of tax, ERP, and business transformation, with a focus on direct and indirect tax integration across SAP FICO, MM, and SD. You will work with client stakeholders, lead teams, and help deliver implementation-driven solutions in a complex global tax environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* SAP DRC, Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.
* Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.

title: Provider Management Specialist
description:
**About Amplify Health**




**Who We Are** 




 Amplify Health is Asia’s leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region.
 



  





 We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS\-based products, PaaS\-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS\-based on\-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value\-chain.
 



  





 Our joint\-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match.
 



  





 We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes.
 



  





**Our Vision and Ambition** 




 To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.
 



 Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value\-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.
 



 By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health\-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.
 



  





**The Position**




**Summary** 




 As a Provider Management Specialist, the role is a specialist advisor position supporting private health insurers to improve their claims risk management, primarily through provider contracting strategy, panel optimisation, patient pathway design, and insurance product alignment.
 



 You will work directly with client teams, enabling them to build stronger provider networks, negotiate effectively, utilise data insights, and apply best‑practice provider management strategies within the healthcare and HealthTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\) On‑Site Client Advisory \& Provider Management Support** 



* Serves as the primary advisor to senior insurer stakeholders to drive and support provider management targets, initiatives and implementations, including, supporting strategic initiatives, contracting cycles, and provider engagement plans.
* Shapes multi‑year provider strategy, including contracting redesign and ecosystem partnerships.
* Develop high‑quality materials for client prep sessions, executive updates, and provider negotiations, ensuring clarity, coherence and insight‑driven storytelling.
* Serve as an embedded advisor supporting the client’s operational and strategic objectives.



**2\) Internal Provider Analytics Product Development** 



* Translate key client needs, pain points, and market insights into product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback to evolve Amplify Health’s provider analytics tools, dashboards and negotiation support solutions.
* Acts as the thought partner to product leadership for long‑term roadmap development.



**3\) Capability Building and Upskilling Client Teams** 



* Identify and prioritize key knowledge gaps and design tailored workshops, demos and training modules to upskill capabilities across client teams.
* Run coaching and role‑play sessions to elevate client teams’ provider negotiation capabilities and commercial acumen to improve negotiations for provider engagements.



  





**Candidate Profile**




**Experience and Qualifications** 



* Over 6 years experience in health insurance, health\-related industries or consulting.
* Demonstrated success in managing cost efficiencies in healthcare, whether at providers, insurers or population health level.
* Proven experience in client advisory work particularly in healthcare related work.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or relevant) strongly preferred.



  





**Competencies \& Core Characteristics:** 




 We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale\-up environment:
 


* **Strategic Architect:** 
 Able to connect disparate information into a cohesive strategy leveraging Amplify Health frameworks. Capable of designing clear, actionable paths for clients navigating complex provider ecosystems.
* **Data\-Driven Decisiveness:** 
 Confidence in working with data, identifying insights, and translating analytics into compelling narratives. Ensures objective, evidence‑based decision‑making in provider negotiations and strategy formulation.
* **Customer‑Obsessed Advocate:** 
 Anticipates client needs and proactively delivers value through insights, structure and advisory support.
* **Resilient Operator:** 
 able to operate in a fluid and changing start\-up environment, flexing between internal work and client facing modes
* **Unifier \& Cross\-Functional Influencer:** 
 Collaborates seamlessly across clinical, analytics, commercial and product teams. Drives alignment and shared understanding between stakeholders.

**1\.6 Business\-Purpose Mortgages**

**1\.7 Insurance Cross\-Sell** 





 ·       
 
**Loan Protection Insurance:** 

 bundled with any loan closed, tying directly into BlissMoney’s existing insurance services.
 





 ·       
 
**MSME / SME Insurance Products:** 

 broader business insurance \- property, liability, and other MSME\-relevant covers \- offered as a cross\-sell alongside lending, not limited to loan protection alone.
 




**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




  





**2\.1 Sourcing Business Banking Relationships** 




 ·       Build a pipeline of SME and corporate clients across working capital, trade finance, term lending and export finance needs \- leveraging existing banking relationships plus BlissMoney’s referral network.
 



 ·       Work leads handed over by the Wealth/RM team and existing client base.
 



**2\.2 Credit Assessment \& Structuring** 




 ·       Assess each client’s working capital cycle, trade flows, and credit need \- structuring a proposal a lender will actually approve.
 



 ·       For trade finance specifically: correctly structure LC, BG and documentary credit requirements, with working knowledge of INCOTERMS and export/import documentation.
 



**2\.3 Syndication \& Placement** 




 ·       Place the structured requirement with the right lender from BlissMoney’s panel of banks/NBFCs, based on rate, turnaround time, and eligibility fit.
 



 ·       For larger or foreign\-currency requirements, structure the facility across more than one lender where needed \- true syndication, not just referral.
 



**2\.4 Lender \& Partner Relationship Management** 




 ·       Build and maintain relationships with banks and NBFCs to secure competitive terms and faster turnaround for BlissMoney clients, across both lending and deposit\-side referrals.
 



**2\.5 Cross\-Sell \& Internal Coordination** 




 ·       Work closely with RMs and the Advisory team to identify banking and insurance cross\-sell opportunities within BlissMoney’s existing client base.
 



 ·       Keep the Advisory team informed when a client takes on new business debt, since it affects their overall financial picture.
 



**2\.6 Compliance \& Documentation** 




 ·       
 **DSA Registration:** 
 BlissMoney operates as a facilitator, partnered with banks and NBFC institutions. This role \- or BlissMoney as an entity \- will be registered as a Direct Selling Agent (DSA) with each partner lender.
 



 ·       Follow RBI and FEMA guidelines on loan sourcing, fair practices and cross\-border trade transactions at every stage. Maintain complete, audit\-ready documentation for every case, including export/import documentation where applicable.
 



**3\. What We’re Looking For** 




  






 ·       
 
**Primary Fit:** 
 currently or previously a Relationship Manager in a bank’s Business Banking Group (BBG), Small \& Business Banking (SBB), Mid\-Enterprise Group (MEG), or Corporate/Trade Finance desk \- or an equivalent business banking role at another bank or NBFC.
 




 ·       
 
 Genuine comfort assessing business credit and trade finance requirements \- reading financial statements, understanding working capital cycles, and structuring proposals across both rupee and foreign\-currency facilities.
 




 ·       
 
 Working knowledge of export/import documentation, RBI/FEMA guidelines governing trade finance and cross\-border transactions.
 




 ·       
 
 Comfort managing a full cycle independently \- from sourcing through structuring to closing \- without a separate handover to another closer.
 




 ·       
 
 Existing relationships with banks/NBFCs and business\-owner clients are a strong advantage, given the target candidate profile above.
 




 ·       
 
 Clear, honest communication \- business banking is a trust\-sensitive relationship, and clients need someone who explains terms plainly, not someone who oversells.

 Assettrust Services Pvt Ltd, founded in July 2014 in Bangalore, is a real estate advisory firm built on transparency, expertise, and client trust. The company provides end\-to\-end consultancy for residential and commercial properties across major Indian cities including Pune, Noida, Delhi, Gurugram, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, and is expanding to Dubai. Assettrust supports clients throughout the property lifecycle, from understanding requirements to coordinating with banks, legal advisors, and developers.  The Relationship Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune/Pimpri\-Chinchwad area. The Relationship Manager will coordinate with internal teams, developers, banks, and legal partners to ensure a seamless transaction process and timely resolution of client queries. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; fluency in local languages (e.g., Marathi, Hindi) is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site, conduct property visits, and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously with attention to detail.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Commerce, Real Estate, or a related field; relevant experience in real estate advisory or financial services is preferred.
* High level of integrity, ethical conduct, and a client\-first mindset aligned with transparent, data\-backed advisory practices.

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.

 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
