title: GROWTH EXECUTIVE
description:
Growth Executive – Student Engagement \& Memberships
   

  

* Reports to the Success Manager


 We're hiring someone whose whole job is to bring people back.
   

  

 Every fitness company talks about new sign\-ups. Fewer talk about the student who trained hard for four months, then life happened — a project, a move, a bad week — and hasn't logged in since.
   

  

 That student is who this role is for.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 In 2026, our growth is driven as much by the students already with us as by new sign\-ups. Attendance, re\-activation and renewals are where the next chapter is won.
   

  

 You'll design comeback campaigns for students who've gone quiet, work with our coaches to understand why people drop off, own renewals end to end, and make sure the membership experience — plan changes, payments, the lot — feels seamless.
   

  

 It's a role for someone who can invent a campaign on Monday and cheerfully chase a pending payment on Tuesday. Creative and operationally disciplined. Warm on the phone, sharp in the spreadsheet.
   

  

 You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our coaching team, because engagement problems are rarely just data problems. They're human ones.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

 Engagement \& re\-activation
   

  

* Plan and run engagement campaigns for inactive, low\-attendance and at\-risk students
* Design creative re\-engagement initiatives — comeback programmes, challenges, win\-back offers, milestone moments
* Work closely with coaches to understand why students drop off, and turn that into
* interventions that actually move attendance


 Memberships \& renewals
   

  

* Communicate with current and past students on attendance, renewals and plan options
* Support membership growth through renewals and relevant cross\-sell and up\-sell conversations — consultative, never transactional
* Own renewal payment follow\-ups end to end. This is a critical part of the role


 Data \& reporting
   

  

* Track and analyse engagement, attendance and membership data to support decisions
* Maintain accurate membership and engagement records in our CRM
* Produce regular reports on engagement, renewals and revenue against quarterly targets


 How you'll work
   

  

* Use CRM tools and Google Workspace to track every effort — nothing lives only in your head
* Look for the automation, then keep the human touch on top of it
* Bring a growth mindset and a start\-up mentality


 What we need from you
   

  

* 2\+ years in customer success, account management, community management, inside sales or a closely related role. Exceptional freshers with the right temperament are welcome to apply
* Strong English communication, verbal and written. You'll write campaign copy and have renewal conversations on the same day
* Comfort owning payment and renewal follow\-ups — persistent, organised, and never awkward about it
* High proficiency with Google Workspace / MS Office, and hands\-on experience with an online CRM
* Ability to read data and turn it into an action, not just a chart
* Creative thinking paired with operational discipline — you can invent a campaign and also run the checklist that ships it
* A calm, patient, empathetic manner with students. Many of the people you'll speak to left because life got hard
* Based in Chennai and able to work on\-site with the coaching team


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience in a B2C, subscription or membership\-led business
* Background in fitness, sports, wellness or education
* Hands\-on with marketing automation or CRM workflow building — WhatsApp or email journeys, lifecycle campaigns
* Spreadsheets beyond the basics — pivots, cohort views, retention curves
* A training practice of your own. It helps you speak our students' language


 Your first 90 days
   

  

 First 30 days You know our membership plans, CRM and student segments cold. You've run your first re\-activation outreach list and sat in on classes with the coaching team. By day 60 You own the renewals follow\-up cycle independently. A first comeback campaign is designed, shipped and measured. By day 90 You're reporting engagement, renewals and revenue on a regular cadence, and you've brought a measurable lift in attendance or renewal rate on at least one student segment.
   

  

 What you get
   

  

* A balanced, respectful work culture that respects your life outside work
* Free membership at The Quad — train with coaches who've transformed thousands of lives
* Health insurance, annual health checkups and wellness support
* Industry\-standard salaries and a generous leave policy
* The chance to positively affect someone's health every single day


 How to apply
   

  

 Use the form below. Along with your details, send us a short note on a time you brought a lapsed customer, member or student back. That note matters more to us than a cover letter.
   

  

 We read every application, and you'll hear from us either way.
   

  

 The Quad is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on capability, character and fit with how we coach.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives

* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.

 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:

**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY** 




 CultureMonkey is an AI\-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100\+ countries and rated 4\.7/5 on G2\.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own the customer journey from adoption through renewal and help customers achieve measurable value from CultureMonkey.
 



 You will build relationships with champions, key stakeholders, and executive sponsors, drive product adoption, monitor account health, and proactively manage risks and opportunities.
 



 This is a strategic, data\-driven role for someone who enjoys solving customer problems, leading meaningful business conversations, and turning customer goals into measurable outcomes.
 



 You will also work closely with our founding team and internal teams to bring customer insights into the business and help shape our Customer Success function.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




 As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will be working on customer engagement efforts, playing a pivotal role in driving success and satisfaction. Your responsibilities will include:
 



  




* Strategic CS Development: Craft and implement cohesive CS strategies tailored to critical stages of the customer journey, including upcoming renewals and QBRs/EBRs.
* Collaborative Insight Sharing: Partner closely with our founding members, providing valuable insights to enhance the overall customer process.
* Innovative Project Management: Strategically plan and execute new projects to identify areas for increased product usage and adoption.
* Creative Customer Campaigns: Develop and launch engaging campaigns to educate and nurture customers on the latest product features.
* Performance Reporting: Regularly report on product adoption, usage, and customer health to our leadership team, ensuring continuous monitoring and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Renewal pipeline generation: Experiment with diverse approaches to maintain a steady, qualified pipeline of renewals.
* Key Metric Tracking: Continuously monitor and report on crucial metrics such as renewals, churn rates, and CSAT scores.
* Operational Oversight: Provide operational oversight to ensure targets and KPIs are met.
* Best Practice Sharing: Educate clients on best practices to achieve product success with CultureMonkey.



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 5\-8 years of experience, with at least 5 years in Customer Success, preferably in B2B SaaS or HR Tech.
* Experience managing strategic or enterprise customer relationships with multiple stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Strong understanding of customer health, adoption, retention, renewals, churn, and CSAT.
* A data\-driven mindset with the ability to turn customer and product data into actionable insights.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with senior and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with strong attention to follow\-through.
* Strong commercial awareness and comfort participating in renewal and expansion conversations.
* A customer\-first, empathetic approach combined with structured and analytical thinking.
* Experience with Customer Success tools, CRM platforms, and analytics tools is a strong advantage.
* Experience working with global customers, preferably in the US, is preferred.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment where ownership matters.



  





**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET** 



* Someone who thinks beyond customer support and understands that great Customer Success is about delivering measurable value.
* Someone who can speak confidently with an HR leader, understand the data behind an account, and turn both into a clear action plan.
* Someone who takes ownership, spots risks early, and follows through.
* Someone who sees renewals as the result of consistently delivering value \- not just a date on the calendar.
* Someone who wants to help build something, not just operate within it.



  





 If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Lead - Franchise Operations and Retail Expansion
description:
**About This Job**
**Pickyourtrail**
**Location:** 
 Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Travel Arrangements,Retail
   

  

**Job Description**
 About the Role:
   

  

 We operate on a FOFO (Franchise\-Owned, Franchise\-Operated) model, where the success
   

  

 of each store depends heavily on the quality, ownership mindset, and operating capability of
   

  

 the franchise partner.
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on operator to own the performance and expansion of this
   

  

 network.
   

  

 This is not a role for someone who wants to manage the business primarily through
   

  

 dashboards and reviews. You will spend significant time in stores, with franchise partners,
   

  

 understanding ground realities, solving operational problems, and building repeatable
   

  

 systems that make our best stores the benchmark for the network.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Store hiring – Hiring is the store partner's own KPI, not yours — but you’ll actively guide


 and support them in hiring the right type of people, with a repeatable toolkit and tighter
   

  

 handoff into our training team.
   

  

* Sales attrition – Also the store partner's KPI. You'll help them diagnose root causes and


 adopt a retention playbook (comp, incentives, career path) rather than owning the
   

  

 outcome directly.
   

  

* Local demand generation – Reduce over\-reliance on centrally\-sourced paid leads by


 building partners' capability to generate local demand (referrals, local tie\-ups,
   

  

 community/corporate outreach).
   

  

* Lead economics \& conversion – Fix cases where partners consume paid leads (50%


 CAC\-charged post month 6\) without converting — via better training, accountability, or
   

  

 lead\-routing fixes.
   

  

* Partner selection \& store health – Sharpen partner vetting toward operators over


 investors; run a regular store review cadence; drive real turnarounds for
   

  

 underperforming stores.
   

  

* Playbook codification – Turn what works in our best stores into a standard playbook for


 new and struggling ones.
   

  

* New store expansion – Scout markets and real estate (500\-600 sq ft,


 high\-street/arterial\- road, high\-visibility), and screen partners rigorously — at the pace
   

  

 needed to hit 20\-25 stores without a quality drop.
   

  

* Leading the Store Ops team – Hire, coach, and manage this team directly. They train


 store staff and resolve tickets (itinerary, pricing, deal support) — conversion stays with
   

  

 the store seller/partner. Set standards for response time, quality, and scale the team as
   

  

 stores grow.
   

  

* Stakeholder management – Work across performance marketing, training, and finance


 to translate store\-level reality into action, and vice versa.
   

  

* Commercial \& compliance ownership – Own franchise LOB budgeting/forecasting,


 track unit economics (CAC vs. revenue by store), and keep franchise agreements
   

  

 compliant.
   

  

**What Does Success Looks Like**
* Underperforming stores show measurable turnaround, or an honest call on the partner


 relationship
   

  

* Documented hiring/onboarding process adopted across most stores; attrition trending


 down

 Full\-Time

 We are hiring an Operations Delivery Manager to own end\-to\-end delivery for our Chennai offshore team – spanning service delivery, platform support, and production operations.

 4\.Stakeholder Management

 5\. Reporting
 


* Own weekly/monthly operational reporting: SLA adherence, delivery timelines, utilization, productivity, risk status.



 Required Experience
 


* 12–16 years in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technology Delivery Management.

* Proven experience owning service delivery, platform support, and production operations at scale.

* Delivery Governance
* Team Leadership
* Capacity Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Risk \& Escalation Management

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration. MBA or relevant certifications are a plus.

title: Property Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Property Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Property Managers to manage the owner and tenant experience across active residential property\-management files.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Strong account, portfolio or client\-service managers with experience managing multiple files, relationships and escalations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 This role is for someone who can keep files moving, keep clients informed, manage urgent issues and remain organized in a high\-volume environment. You will be responsible for communication, follow\-up, documentation, issue resolution and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
   

  

 This is not a basic customer\-service position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of client outcomes, manage multiple properties and files simultaneously, and communicate professionally with property owners, tenants, internal teams and service providers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Act as the main point of contact for property owners and tenants throughout the management relationship.
* Manage multiple active clients, properties and files with strong organization and follow\-through.
* Provide proactive updates so owners understand what is happening, what is pending and what comes next.
* Handle time\-sensitive property and tenancy matters with urgency, professionalism and clear communication.
* Coordinate next steps between owners, tenants, internal departments, vendors and other service providers.
* Collect, review and track required property, owner and tenant documentation.
* Maintain complete CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow\-ups, updates and file movement.
* Identify stalled files, missed follow\-ups, client concerns and service problems before they escalate.
* Escalate serious issues promptly and use sound judgment to protect client satisfaction.
* Support a structured, process\-driven property\-management experience from onboarding through ongoing management.


**Requirements**
* Three to five or more years of property management, account management, client success, client services, relationship management or comparable client\-ownership experience.
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients, properties, accounts or active files simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and confidence handling owner, tenant or client concerns.
* Strong process discipline and comfort working within a structured CRM and task\-management system.
* Strong follow\-up habits, task management and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize quickly in a high\-volume environment.
* Professional judgment when handling complaints, escalations, deadlines and sensitive client matters.
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
* Excellent written and spoken English.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Direct property\-management, leasing, real estate operations or housing\-related experience.
* Experience supporting both clients and end users, such as owners and tenants or customers and service providers.
* Experience working with North American clients.
* Experience in a high\-volume, service\-based, operations\-heavy or SLA\-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating maintenance, leasing, payments, documentation or service\-provider activities.
* Comfort using AI and other tools to improve documentation, reporting, summaries and internal efficiency.


 Remote Technology Requirements
   

  

* Dual\-monitor setup
* Computer with at least 16GB of RAM
* Reliable internet connection of at least 100 Mbps
* Webcam
* Noise\-cancelling headset
* Professional and quiet environment for calls


**Compensation**
 Total annual compensation ranges from
 **C$30,000 to C$36,000** 
 , based on experience, qualifications and performance.
   

  

 Candidates with direct property\-management experience, strong owner and tenant communication skills, and proven success managing a high volume of active files may be considered near the top of the range.
   

  

 Complete details regarding base compensation and performance bonuses will be shared during the interview process.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview from our recruitment partner within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom
